hazardStep_earthquake_1: During shaking, drop, take cover under a sturdy table, and hold on.
hazardStep_earthquake_2: Stay away from windows, shelves, and anything that can fall.
hazardStep_earthquake_3: When the shaking stops, go outside to an open area. Use the stairs, not the lift.
hazardStep_earthquake_4: Near the coast, move to higher ground straight away if the shaking was strong or long.
hazardStep_flood_1: Move to higher ground and keep away from rivers and drains.
hazardStep_flood_2: Do not walk or drive through moving water.
hazardStep_flood_3: Switch off electricity at the main if water is entering your home.
hazardStep_flood_4: Keep documents, medicine, and a charged phone in a waterproof bag.
hazardStep_volcano_1: Stay outside the danger radius set by the authorities.
hazardStep_volcano_2: Wear a mask and glasses when ash is falling, and cover water containers.
hazardStep_volcano_3: Keep away from rivers that start on the volcano; they can carry lahars after rain.
hazardStep_volcano_4: Be ready to leave as soon as an evacuation is announced.
hazardStep_haze_1: Stay indoors with doors and windows closed when the air is smoky.
hazardStep_haze_2: Wear a well-fitting mask (N95 or KN95) if you must go out.
hazardStep_haze_3: Avoid heavy outdoor activity, especially for children, older adults, and people with asthma.
hazardStep_haze_4: See a health worker if you have trouble breathing.
hazardStep_fire_1: Leave straight away and keep low under the smoke.
hazardStep_fire_2: Do not go back for belongings.
hazardStep_fire_3: Call the fire service on 113 once you are safe.
hazardStep_fire_4: If fire is spreading across land near you, move upwind and away from dry vegetation.
hazardStep_wind_1: Go inside a sturdy building and stay away from windows.
hazardStep_wind_2: Keep away from trees, billboards, and power lines.
hazardStep_wind_3: Bring loose items indoors or tie them down.
hazardStep_wind_4: If you are driving, stop somewhere safe, away from trees.
hazardStep_earthquake_1_mobility: During shaking, lock your wheels or sit down, bend forward, and cover your head and neck with your arms.
hazardStep_earthquake_3_mobility: When the shaking stops, move to an open area by a step-free route. Do not use the lift; ask for help with stairs.
hazardStep_flood_1_mobility: Leave early for higher ground while routes are still passable, and tell your Buddy you are moving.
hazardStep_fire_1_mobility: Leave straight away by the nearest step-free exit and keep as low as you can under the smoke.
